note: English 90-second cut. 'text' is sent to TTS ('Beleckt' is a pronunciation hint for 'Belegt'); 'sub' is the burned-in subtitle.

lines.text: This is what an AI does when it doesn't know: it makes things up, with total confidence.
lines.sub: This is what an AI does when it doesn't know: it makes things up, with total confidence.

lines.text: Even Apertus, the Swiss model, asked on its own: “Article 30 sets the maximum price of bread.” That article doesn't exist.
lines.sub: Even Apertus, asked on its own: “Article 30 sets the maximum price of bread.” That article doesn't exist.

lines.text: Beleckt is built on Apertus, the open Swiss AI. Its rule fits in three words: cite, or stay silent.
lines.sub: Belegt is built on Apertus, the open Swiss AI. Its rule fits in three words: cite, or stay silent.

lines.text: First question: the right to demonstrate. Apertus reads it and rephrases it in four languages. Then plain code, with no AI, checks every quote, word for word.
lines.sub: First question: the right to demonstrate. Apertus reads it and rephrases it in four languages. Then plain code, with no AI, checks every quote, word for word.

lines.text: One click: the sentence, highlighted in the official text. In German, in Romansh: the same provision.
lines.sub: One click: the sentence, highlighted in the official text. In German, in Romansh: the same provision.

lines.text: The same question in Romansh. Beleckt answers in Romansh, and all four official versions lead to the same article. Four languages, one law.
lines.sub: The same question in Romansh. Belegt answers in Romansh, and all four official versions lead to the same article. Four languages, one law.

lines.text: No foreign service: this whole demo runs in an isolated network, with zero outbound connections. And the answer still arrives.
lines.sub: No foreign service: this whole demo runs in an isolated network, with zero outbound connections. And the answer still arrives.

lines.text: Now a trap: which article sets the maximum price of bread? None does. Beleckt says so, and claims nothing.
lines.sub: Now a trap: which article sets the maximum price of bread? None does. Belegt says so, and claims nothing.

lines.text: Every answer comes with a receipt: model, law version, evidence, checks.
lines.sub: Every answer comes with a receipt: model, law version, evidence, checks.

lines.text: Same model, same questions. Wrong or invented articles: 59 percent alone, 5 percent with Beleckt. 19 traps out of 19 refused.
lines.sub: Same model, same questions. Wrong or invented articles: 59% alone, 5% with Belegt. Traps refused: 19/19.

lines.text: This is Beleckt. Prove it, or stay silent.
lines.sub: This is Belegt. Prove it, or stay silent.
